title: Dodgers force World Series to decisive Game 7 by holding off Blue Jays 3-1
summary: Yoshinobu Yamamoto beat Toronto for the second time in a week, as the defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers held off the Blue Jays 3-1 on Friday night to force the World Series to a decisive Game 7.
